acceptanceCriteria: Resolved as the finding's Fix describes, with a regression test for any code change, or closed by an owner decision that rejects the finding.
Inject failures after receipt publication, before/after barrier unlink, and before/after head publication; supported recovery settles the identical pending receipt.
Recover twice with no further state change; verify changed barrier bytes refuse without overwrite.
After recovery, queue/ticket reads succeed and receipt chain/projection audit passes.
body:
Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review (main report or Beamfall/corvint-tasks addendum; confirmed by at least one verifier). Finding text: **F2. A pending redo blocks reads, can be cleared only with the primary on the intent branch, and readers report in-flight writers as crashes.** - **Severity:** medium. - **Core:** no. - **Location:** `tasks-src/internal/store/redo.go:52` (`requireBranch` before redo) and `store.go` `settled()`. - **Failure:** - After a C2 crash, `queue status`, `ticket list`, `roadmap`, `ticket show` and `gate list` return NOT_RUN REDO_PENDING. `release list` still works. - An agent on a feature branch cannot recover, because the retry is refused with INTENT_BRANCH_MISMATCH. - Under a concurrent writer, 14 of 60 reads returned REDO_PENDING with crash remediation text. - **Fix:** - Add a branch-independent `recover` verb, since redo only replays committed bytes. - Have readers try a non-blocking flock and report WRITER_ACTIVE when it is held. - Name the branch precondition in the remediation text. - **Votes:** 1/0/1. - **Known ticket:** none.

Audit addendum 2026-09-26 (STO-01), source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a: A returned I/O fault or interruption after the UNPAUSE receipt is published and before barrier deletion/head advancement. This occurs even when all staging slots are cleaned. The committed receipt remains pending. Retrying unpause returns REDO_PENDING; generic mutation redo refuses the null post with UNSUPPORTED. Supported commands cannot settle the journal, so store use requires manual recovery. This is an acknowledged implementation-slice limitation, not a claim of corruption or violation of a recovered accepted task-store contract.
Source: internal/tasks/store/redo.go:121; internal/tasks/store/barrier_test.go:151; internal/tasks/store/barrier_test.go:172; internal/tasks/cli/cli.go:117.
Verification: "PASS: GOCACHE=/tmp/corvint-go-build-cache GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/trace ./internal/tasks/store -run TestAppend(RecoversInterruptedRetention|InterruptedRecoveryRemainsRetryable|RetentionPostPublishSyncFailureRecoversOnRetry)|TestApplyMigrationAtCandidateLimit|TestTMV0009_AS11_BarrierPublicationReturnedFaults. Existing barrier test provides deterministic returned-fault reproduction; no process-kill or power-cut experiment."
Correction: Extend explicit task-store recovery to a receipt-authorized barrier deletion: delete only the exact preimage, accept already absent postimage, refuse any third value, sync deletion before head advancement. Include this scope in the recover work for V1-0309.
See .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md and .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/ for original evidence. This addendum does not claim implementation or promotion.
